title: Biggest upsets
intro: The matches won with the lowest chance of winning, week by week.
explanation:
The win chance is from the ratings right before the match. Only matches between settled players count. Every player must have:

- played at least 10 matches
- a rating certain to within ±250 in singles or ±180 in doubles: we're about 95% sure their true level is that close to their rating. The uncertainty grows while a player isn't playing, so after a long break a rating can fall outside it

So a junior improving fast who beats a favourite isn't counted as an upset. Walkovers and draws are left out.
